시편-80-2.title: 시편 80장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-80-2.exegesis: PSALM 80 Psa 80:1-19 . Shoshannim--"Lilies" (see on Psa 45:1 , title). Eduth--Testimony, referring to the topic as a testimony of God to His people (compare Psa 19:7 ). This Psalm probably relates to the captivity of the ten tribes, as the former to that of Judah. Its complaint is aggravated by the contrast of former prosperity, and the prayer for relief occurs as a refrain through the Psalm. 1-2. Joseph-- for Ephraim ( 1Ch 7:20-29 ; Psa 78:67 ; Re 7:8 ), for Israel. Shepherd-- (Compare Ge 49:24 ). leadest, &c.-- ( Psa 77:20 ). dwellest ... cherubim-- ( Ex 25:20 ); the place of God's visible glory, whence He communed with the people ( He 9:5 ). shine forth-- appear ( Psa 50:2 ; 94:1 ).

시편-80-18.title: 시편 80장 18절 역사문법적 주해
시편-80-18.exegesis: 17. thy hand ... upon-- that is, strengthen ( Ezr 7:6 ; 8:22 ). man of ... hand-- may allude to Benjamin ( Ge 35:18 ). The terms in the latter clause correspond with those of Psa 80:15 , from "and the branch," &c., literally, and confirm the exposition given above.
